pillars.title: Generering van Series Room
pillars.body: Beskryf jou reeks of YouTube-kanaal eenmalig, en SceneFlow bou die hele wêreld — storielyn, rolverdeling en 'n onbeperkte lys episodes — met behulp van 'n gedeelde Reference Library wat verseker dat elke episode by die handelsmerk pas.

steps.title: Begin met jou konsep
steps.description: Voer 'n konsep of 'n gedetailleerde beskrywing van jou reeks of YouTube-kanaal in. SceneFlow omskep dit in 'n gestruktureerde, produksiegereed grondslag — geen "prompt engineering" word vereis nie.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Ontvangs van nuwe reekse — konsep- of kanaalbeskrywing

steps.title: Hersien die SceneFlow-basislyn
steps.description: SceneFlow lewer 'n professionele basislyn op wat deur Audience Resonance-analise gegradeer is. Lees of luister na die vertelde oorsig en stuur dit dan in jou eie rigting.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reeksbasislyn — Audience Resonance-telling en toegeligte oorsig

steps.title: Skep onbeperkte episodes
steps.description: Skep soveel episodes as wat jou storie vereis. Elkeen erf jou reeks se DNA, sodat die rolverdeling, toon en wêreld konsekwent bly van die eerste episode tot by die seisoen-eindstryd.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Lys van episodes — onbeperkte episodes gegenereer uit die reeksboog

steps.title: Hersien die Reference Library
steps.description: Blaai deur die gedeelde Reference Library — karakters, stemme, kostuums, liggings en rekwisiete — wat deur Production Stage geskep en in stand gehou word en in elke episode hergebruik word.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Gedeelde Reference Library — karakters, stemme, liggings, rekwisiete

steps.title: Gee opdragte aan die intelligente skryfassistent
steps.description: Vorm die reeks of enige episode opnuut deur jou instruksies uit te spreek of in te tik. Die intelligente skryfassistent herskryf professionele teks onmiddellik – geen leë bladsy of ingewikkelde opdragformulering is nodig nie.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligente Assistent-skrywer — leiding oor stem of teks vir reekse en episodes

steps.title: Begin produksie met een klik
steps.description: Wanneer 'n episode reg voel, begin die produksie daarvan met 'n enkele klik en beweeg direk oor na die begeleide Production Stage-pyplyn.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Begin produksie van 'n geselekteerde episode met een klik

pillars.title: SFAIBLUEPRINT_KAMERTERM
pillars.body: Blueprint Room is jou omvattende filmbehandeling — sinopsis, narratiewe mylpale, karakters, toon en styl — wat vooraf geëvalueer is deur middel van Audience Resonance-analise, sodat jy ’n storie kan goedkeur wat aanklank vind nog voordat ’n enkele raampie weergegee word.

steps.title: Hersien die basislyn-Blueprint
steps.description: Maak 'n professionele Blueprint-basislyn oop waarin Audience Resonance-analise ingebou is. Lees of luister na die toegeligte oorsig om presies te hoor waarom dit werk.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Basislyn-Blueprint — behandeling met Audience Resonance-telling

steps.title: Gee opdragte aan die intelligente skryfassistent
steps.description: Verfyn die sinopsis, narratiewe stappe, karakters en meer deur jou instruksies uit te spreek of in te tik. Die intelligente skryfassistent hersien die draaiboekskets onmiddellik – sonder dat ingewikkelde opdragte (prompt engineering) nodig is.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligente skryfassistent — redigering van sinopsis, narratiewe stappe en karakters

steps.title: Hersien die redenasie
steps.description: Maak die afdeling vir redenasie oop vir 'n kreatiewe verduideliking van die huidige Blueprint — die storie-logika agter elke narratiewe stap en karakterkeuse.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Redeneringspaneel — kreatiewe verduideliking van die Blueprint

steps.title: Begin produksie wanneer gereed
steps.description: Sodra die storie regtig lewe kry, begin met produksie — en die hele produksieproses neem jou goedgekeurde kreatiewe DNA oor, sonder enige afwyking.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Open Production Stage — gereedheidspoort vanaf 'n goedgekeurde bloudruk

pillars.title: SFAIPRODUKSIE_STADIUMTERMYN
pillars.body: Production Stage voer gelyktydige generering deur verskeie enjins uit — vir draaiboek, oudio, rame en video — tesame met die Intelligent Assistant Director, die Screening Room en veeltalige strome wat die proses van 'n goedgekeurde draaiboek tot by 'n gepubliseerde 4K-meesterkopie voer.

steps.title: Hersien die basislynskrif
steps.description: Begin met 'n professionele basisdraaiboek wat Audience Resonance-analise insluit. Lees of luister na die toegeligte analise om te weet wat aanklank vind voordat jy 'n krediet bestee.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Basislyndraaiboek — Audience Resonance-ontleding en toegeligte oorsig

steps.title: Optimaliseer toneel vir toneel
steps.description: Gebruik die intelligente skryfassistent om die draaiboek toneel vir toneel te optimaliseer — verfyn dialoog, hervorm narratiewe momente en pas verbeterings met 'n enkele klik toe, hetsy deur middel van stem of teks.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligente skryfassistent — optimalisering van draaiboeke toneel vir toneel

steps.title: Bou die Reference Library
steps.description: Skep of werk die Reference Library by met karakters, stemme, kostuums, liggings en rekwisiete wat volgens draaiboek geskep, pasgemaak of opgelaai is. Wysig verwysingsbeelde direk — geen "slotmasjien"-hergenererings nie.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reference Library — karakters, stemme, kostuums, liggings, rekwisiete

steps.title: Genereer oudio
steps.description: Genereer dialoog, vertelling, klankeffekte en musiek met Run All Agents oor alle tonele heen, Audio Agent per toneel, of stap vir stap — stemopnames van moedertaalgehalte in meer as 70 tale.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Audio Agent — alle tonele, 'n enkele toneel of slag vir slag

steps.title: Genereer en wysig rame
steps.description: Genereer "beat"-rame met Run All Agents en Stills Agent per toneel of stap vir stap, en wysig dan enige raam met die Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD) — beskryf bloot die verandering.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Pas rame aan met Intelligent Assistant Director-redigering

steps.title: Hersien die animatic
steps.description: Speel die volledige animatic — rame, dialoog, klankeffekte en musiek — in die interaktiewe Screening Room, en deel 'n skakel vir terugvoer sonder om 'n lêer uit te voer.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Screening Room — interaktiewe hersiening en deel van animatics

steps.title: Genereer video
steps.description: Skakel goedgekeurde rame om in beweging met Video Agent, hetsy per toneel of stap vir stap. Herneem enige skoot met die Intelligent Assistant Director — sonder eindelose hergenererings soos by 'n dobbelmasjien.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Generering van Video Agent met IAD-heropnames

steps.title: Wysig in die mengpaneel
steps.description: Verfyn elke toneel in die Mixer — onderskrifte, snoeiwerk, oorklanking, oorlegsels en klankbalans — vir 'n handelsmerkveilige eindresultaat sonder om die ateljee te verlaat.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Menger — onderskrifte, snoei, oorklanking en klankkontroles

steps.title: Tonele weergee en hersien
steps.description: Genereer jou tonele, en hersien en deel dit dan via die Screening Room om goedkeuring te verkry voor die finale samestelling.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Gerenderde tonele nagegaan en gedeel in die Screening Room

steps.title: Genereer meertalige strome
steps.description: Skep nagesynchroniseerde of lip-gesinkroniseerde taalweergawes vanuit dieselfde goedgekeurde snit – bereik meer as 70 markte sonder om 'n enkele raampie oor te skiet.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Veeltalige strome — oorklank en lipsinchronisasie per streek

steps.title: Genereer finale weergawe en publiseer
steps.description: Genereer die finale produksie as 'n meesterkopie en publiseer dit – met outomaties gegenereerde kleinkiekies, titels en beskrywings wat gereed is vir jou YouTube-kanaal en verder.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Finale weergawe en publisering na YouTube met een klik

features.title: New Series
features.description: Pitch your series, anthology, or episodic channel concept in plain language. Interactive AI refinement sharpens your premise, target audience, and visual tone before generating a complete multi-episode season baseline—complete with overarching plot arcs, recurring character hooks, and episode-by-episode breakdowns.
features.screenshot: Create New Series — intent, Clarify and Confirm, Generate Series

items.title: Plain-language series pitch
items.description: Pitch the premise, episode format, target demographic, and visual art style in plain language.

items.title: Interactive Clarify & Confirm
items.description: Clarify and Confirm sharpens the season synopsis, tone, and thematic pillars with you before anything is generated.

items.title: Multi-episode season baseline
items.description: Generate Series builds a structured five-episode season arc with individual synopses and story hooks that you can expand anytime.

items.title: World & genre calibration
items.description: Lock visual aesthetics, era settings, and recurring narrative motifs up front so every episode shares the same creative DNA.

features.title: Season Bible & Continuity
features.description: Read or listen to the narrated season overview and episode slate. SceneFlow locks your story threads, cast profiles, recurring locations, and signature props into a shared Reference Library that every episode inherits automatically—eliminating continuity drift across multi-part storytelling.
features.screenshot: Overview Listen, Episodes Listen, Consistency, Continuity — Cast, Locations, Props, Settings

items.title: Narrated season & episode audit
items.description: Audit the overarching season overview and every individual episode synopsis with built-in studio audio narration.

items.title: Cross-episode story consistency
items.description: Visual aesthetics, canonical plot events, and character relationship threads stay locked across the entire season.

items.title: Shared Reference Library inheritance
items.description: Cast portraits, voice profiles, wardrobes, locations, and signature props carry automatically into every episode you produce.

items.title: Centralized canon management
items.description: Update a character look, location plate, or prop once in the Series Bible to propagate the change to future episodes.

features.title: Audience Resonance
features.description: Test your season arc against your target demographic before writing a single script. Review episode-by-episode resonance scores, binge-retention curves, and structural critiques, then apply data-backed story improvements with one click—only when you agree with the note.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance analysis, then Actionable Insights, unapplied

items.title: Demographic & retention scoring
items.description: Multi-axis scores and structural analysis reveal how your season arc and episode cliffhangers land with your target audience.

items.title: Episode-by-episode diagnostics
items.description: Spot mid-season pacing dips, character underutilization, or tonal drift across the full episode slate before scripting.

items.title: Director's prerogative
items.description: Actionable Insights update your series bible and episode outlines only when you explicitly choose to apply them.

features.title: The Series Director
features.description: Reshape the entire season by voice or text. Shift the dramatic tone, raise the stakes, introduce a new antagonist, or rework a character arc across all episodes at once while keeping the rest of your storyline and continuity bible intact.
features.screenshot: Series Director — direction, focus, accept

items.title: Plain-language season direction
items.description: Speak or type your creative note and target overarching plot, characters, episode arcs, tone, or world setting.

items.title: Surgical multi-episode updates
items.description: Nothing changes until you accept the previewed revision, and unrelated story threads stay completely untouched.

items.title: Guided AI recommendations
items.description: Apply one-click story improvements surfaced by Audience Resonance or steer every creative choice yourself.

features.title: Episode-Level Direction
features.description: Zoom into any individual episode to rework its plot outline, act structure, pacing, or cold-open hook in isolation—without destabilizing neighboring episodes or mutating the rest of your season slate.
features.screenshot: Episodes — Direct this episode, other episodes unchanged

items.title: Isolated episode rewrites
items.description: Direct changes to a single episode's synopsis, act beats, and character focus without altering neighboring episodes.

items.title: Locked season integrity
items.description: The overarching season bible, shared cast continuity, and remaining episode slate stay locked while you iterate.

items.title: Pre-launch beat polishing
items.description: Refine individual episode hooks and cliffhangers until the episode is ready to launch into the Blueprint Room.

features.title: One-Click Episode Launch
features.description: When an episode's outline hits the mark, launch it straight into the Blueprint Room with a single click—bringing its synopsis, narrative beats, recurring cast, voice profiles, locations, and visual style automatically wired in.
features.screenshot: Start Project — outline and cast already on the episode

items.title: Instant Blueprint handoff
items.description: Launch any approved episode directly into the Blueprint Room with a single click to begin detailed beat and script work.

items.title: Pre-wired creative DNA
items.description: The episode outline, synopsis, story beats, cast profiles, wardrobes, and locations travel automatically with zero re-entry.

items.title: Parallel episode production
items.description: Spin up multiple episodes from the same season slate as independent projects that share the same canonical series assets.

items.title: Zero script refactoring

items.title: You hold the creative lock

items.title: Selective one-click application

items.title: Shareable Blueprint review

groups.headline: Praat die taal van film, nie die sintaksis van opdragte nie.

features.title: Scene Production Workflow (Fullscreen)
features.description: Open the dedicated Fullscreen Scene Production Studio to direct every stage of a scene from one unified 8-tab command bar (`Direction · Audio · Music · Continuity · Stills · Clips · Mixer · Streams`). Reorder shots in the left-hand Shot Rail with live readiness badges, inspect the 16:9 Still & Clip Stage alongside structured camera, blocking, emotion, and lighting cards, and track end-to-end scene completion without losing context.
features.screenshot: Scene Production Workflow (Fullscreen) — 8-tab linear studio, sortable Shot Rail, and structured Shot Direction Workbench

items.title: 8-tab fullscreen linear studio
items.description: Move seamlessly across Direction, Audio, Music, Continuity, Stills, Clips, Mixer, and Streams inside a distraction-free fullscreen workspace.

items.title: Sortable Shot Rail & live badges
items.description: Drag to reorder shots in the left-hand rail while tracking real-time badges for Action, Dialogue, Narration, SFX, Music, Signage, Final 4K stills, and clips In the Can.

items.title: Structured Shot Direction Workbench
items.description: Inspect the 16:9 Still & Clip Stage beside structured cards for spoken beats, camera lens and motion, talent blocking and gaze, lighting, locked continuity refs, and compiled prompts.

items.title: End-to-end scene pipeline telemetry
items.description: Monitor readiness across direction, voice and score, keyframes, multi-take clips, broadcast mixing, and localized streams before publishing.

features.title: The Scene & Shot Director
features.description: Type or speak your direction in plain language. Tell the agent who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is. The Shot Director automatically writes the complex underlying prompts for your stills and clips while syncing camera lens, focal length, talent blocking, and lighting across the scene.
features.screenshot: The Scene & Shot Director — plain-language direction for stills and clips

items.title: Plain-language film direction
items.description: Type or speak who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is without writing bracketed prompt syntax.

items.title: Scene-wide or per-shot precision

items.title: Automatic prompt compilation

items.title: Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD)

items.title: Generate, upload, or surgically edit

items.title: Continuity readiness gate
items.description: Verify that all cast, wardrobe, location, and prop anchors are locked in the Continuity tab before generating scene keyframes.

items.description: Package your script with a Pre-Vis Animatic and Promo Trailers to pitch and acquire project funding.

groups.headline: Bewys die snit voordat jy die berekening spandeer.
groups.description: Moenie raai hoe 'n toneel sal speel nie. SceneFlow skei oudio en stil-opwekking van duur bewegingsweergawe, sodat jy eers die ritme van die redigering kan ouditeer.

features.description: Generate expressive character dialogue, narrator voiceover, action sound effects, and musical scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene. Cast voices automatically match character profiles from your Continuity Library or can be custom-tuned per beat.
features.screenshot: The Audio Agent — concurrent dialogue, sound effects, and music scores

items.description: Generate dialogue, narration, sound effects, and music scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene.

items.title: Locked character voice casting
items.description: Cast voices automatically match character profiles from your Reference Library or can be custom-tuned for timbre and cadence.

items.title: Batch scene or single-shot runs
items.description: Run the Audio Agent across the entire scene in one pass or regenerate individual dialogue and SFX beats on demand.

features.description: Open the Fullscreen `Audio` and `Music` tabs to direct every sonic layer of your scene. Shape vocal performances with emotional delivery tags (`[obsessive, muttered]`) and Hi-Fi Studio quality, extract embedded audio directly from video clips, dial in SFX duration presets (`Auto`, `Short 3s`, `Medium 8s`, `Long 15s`), and compose multi-shot Lyria musical score cues with custom intro fades.
features.screenshot: Dialogue, SFX & Musical Score Workbench — Fullscreen Audio & Music tabs with score cues, voice casting, and SFX duration presets

items.title: Multi-shot musical score cues

items.title: Performance Director & delivery tags
items.description: Direct spoken dialogue with bracketed emotional delivery tags, Hi-Fi Studio synthesis, and per-shot voice casting.

items.title: Precision SFX duration presets
items.description: Time action sound effects to your shot choreography using Auto, Short 3s, Medium 8s, or Long 15s duration presets.

items.title: Extract audio from video clips
items.description: Pull embedded audio directly from generated motion clips to preserve native on-camera speech or ambient foley.

SceneFlow omskep jou nis in 'n produk: herhaalbare innameprosesse, "white-label"-sjablone, stemkloning vir vertelling en 'n duidelike roete van die opdrag tot die finale MP4-aflewering.

example.challengeTitle: Pasgemaakte vertikale marksegmente, geen herhaalbare stelsel nie
example.challengeDescription: Kliënte in die sektore vir memoires, nalatenskappe, vaste eiendom en onderwys benodig vinnige omkeertye — maar elke projek begin van voor af. Die oorhandiging van individuele aflewerbares, tesame met die herhaalde aanpassingsprosesse (soos by 'n dobbelmasjien) wat betrokke is by draaiboeke, beeldmateriaal, stemopnames, video, musiek en redigeringshulpmiddels, vreet aan die winsmarges op hoë volumes.
example.solutionDescription: Ontwikkel herhaalbare werkvloeie vir ateljees wat op memoires fokus en vir gespesialiseerde marksegmente. Sluit die oplaai van sjablone, stemklone, avatars en goedkeuring van voorlopige visualisering in — pas dit aan vir elke kliënt en verhoog marges deur middel van volume.
example.win: Loods ’n videobiografie- of nismark-studiodiens wat herhaalbaar gelewer kan word – nie net ’n eenmalige vryskuttaak nie.

paths.label: Agentskap
paths.outcome: Vinniger voorleggings en skaalbare dienslewering aan kliënte
paths.narrative: Om 'n voorlegging te wen, beteken dat jy die idee moet wys — nie net beskryf nie — maar voorlopige visualisering en lokalisering vreet aan die winsmarge nog voordat die kontrak onderteken is. SceneFlow stel voorlopige visualisering wat gereed is vir kliënte vinnig aan belanghebbendes bekend en skaal dan die lewering oor veldtogte en meer as 70 tale heen, sonder om die werkstroom vir elke rekening van nuuts af te bou.

example.challengeTitle: Lewering aan kliënte op groot skaal
example.challengeDescription: Om die aanbieding te wen, is slegs die helfte van die stryd. Herhalende werk vir kliënte vereis vinnige afhandeling — maar die oordrag van individuele aflewerbares en die herhaalde, onvoorspelbare generering van video-opsies (soos by 'n slotmasjien) oor afsonderlike skeppings- en redigeringshulpmiddels heen, vertraag elke siklus.
example.solutionDescription: Skakel oor van voorleggingspesifikasies na herhalende lewering, met maatreëls wat die handelsmerk beskerm, kliëntbeoordeling voor die finale weergawe, en voorspelbare kredietkoste per projek.
example.win: Lewer vinniger voorleggingsiklusse en herhalende kliëntewerk met minder produksierisiko en groter winsmarges.

paths.narrative: Voorvisualisering en gehoortoetsing het voorheen weke se storieborde, tydelike stemopnames en duur raaiwerk behels voordat die kameras begin rol het. SceneFlow omskep jou draaiboek in 'n interaktiewe animatic met die Pre-vis Agent — optimaliseer dit met Audience Resonance, vertoon dit in die Screening Room, en stel slegs begroting beskikbaar sodra die storie werklik tref.

example.solutionDescription: Laai jou draaiboek op (MDX, FDX en ander formate), optimaliseer dit met Audience Resonance, en genereer 'n interaktiewe voorvisualisering om te vertoon en te toets — met Production Agents wat instruksies (prompts) opstel en inhoud oor verskillende narratiewe segmente heen genereer, in meer as 70 taalopsies en met vinnige veeltalige oorlegsels.
example.win: Bevestig dat die storie by die gehoor pas vóór die hoofopnames — met 'n deelbare animatic, nie 'n voorvisualiseringsproses wat weke lank duur nie.

Stel die beeldverhouding in Blueprint vas sodat die skrifgenerering toneelaanwysings skep wat by die raam pas.

pillars.title: Die kunsstyl bepaal die prosa.
pillars.description: Noir-anime en Pixar-3D vereis verskillende dialoog, atmosfeer en tempo. Kies jou visuele styl in Blueprint, en die LLM verweef daardie tekstuur in die draaiboek se DNS – nie bloot as 'n filter wat agterna toegepas word nie.

steps.detailedDescription: SceneFlow aanvaar idees in gewone taal of gestruktureerde draaiboekformate. Die KI help om konsepte tot draaiboeksketse uit te brei en kan bestaande draaiboeke invoer, sodat jy nooit van 'n leë bladsy af hoef te begin nie.
steps.screenshotSlot: Voeg skermskoot in: Dialoogvenster vir die invoer van 'n nuwe projekkonsep of die invoer van 'n draaiboek

steps.stepLabel: Optimaliseer jou konsep met Blueprint Room
steps.shortDescription: Verwerk idees tot 'n gestruktureerde uiteensetting — loglyn, narratiewe mylpale, karakters en toon — voordat intensiewe weergawe plaasvind.
steps.detailedDescription: Blueprint stel outomaties 'n omvattende storie-uiteensetting saam. Verfyn karakterontwikkeling, storiemylpale en die narratiewe toon met intelligente voorstelle. Deurskakels vir medewerkers stel belanghebbendes in staat om die materiaal te hersien voor Production Stage.

steps.stepLabel: Optimaliseer jou skrip met Audience Resonance
steps.shortDescription: Evalueer jou draaiboek se geskiktheid vir die teikengehoor en pas aanbevelings vir elke toneel toe met oplossings wat net een klik verg.
steps.detailedDescription: Audience Resonance (AR) ontleed jou draaiboek krities aan die hand van die gehoor wat jy definieer. Kry tellings per afdeling, praktiese aanbevelings en begeleide redigering — pas regstellings outomaties per toneel toe of bring algemene veranderinge aan die draaiboek aan vanuit die AR-dialoogvenster.

steps.shortDescription: Genereer dialoogklank en sleutelrame (shot frames) toneel vir toneel. Deel animatics vir goedkeuring voordat die finale uitgawe vir die video aangegaan word.
steps.detailedDescription: Pre-Vis Studio genereer regie-aanwysings, oudio en sleutelrame per toneel – mylpale wat duur herwerkings tot die minimum beperk wanneer karakters of die toon verander. Deel die speler vir samewerking; die volledige animatic kan vir baie projekte as die finale produk dien.

steps.shortDescription: Genereer elke skoot in Clips, meng oudio in die Mixer en voer taalweergawes uit in Streams.
steps.detailedDescription: Snitte genereer die video vir elke opname vanuit goedgekeurde stilbeelde. Die menger bepaal die tydsberekening, watermerke en oudio. Strome is die taalweergawes van die toneel.
subPoints: Snitte — video-opnames gebaseer op goedgekeurde stilbeelde
Menger — watermerk, teks-oorleg en klanktydsberekening per toneel
Strome — taalweergawes van die toneel, gereed vir Screening Room

steps.stepLabel: Toets jou produksie met Screening Room
steps.shortDescription: Bekyk toneelvideo's in volgorde, stel 'n meester-MP4 saam en hou vertonings wat gedeel kan word, met gestruktureerde terugvoer.
steps.detailedDescription: Screening Room weerspieël die gebruikerservaring van die Pre-Vis-speler, maar speel weergegee toneelstrome af. Kies Animatic of video per toneel, stel 'n meester saam, deel hersieningsskakels en prioritiseer terugvoer met tydstempels voordat dit gepubliseer word.

steps.shortDescription: Versprei jou meesteropname na YouTube, voer kort snitte uit en volg gehoorinsigte na – alles vanaf een afwerkingsplatform.
steps.detailedDescription: Gebruik Screening Room om die YouTube-publiseringsassistent te laat loop, kortformaat-inhoud vir sosiale media te skep en verspreidingspakkette af te laai. Ontledings en terugvoer van beoordelaars bly op een plek – geen oordrag na afsonderlike hulpmiddels nie.

cards.title: Rolprentlange filmdrama. Geen karakterafwyking nie.
cards.subtitle: Behou karaktergesigte, kostuums en liggings van toneel 1 tot toneel 100. Gaan na die vertoningskamer om die *pre-vis*, die bewegingsvideo per toneel en die finale ProRes 4K-meesterkopie te sien — en skakel dan oor na 'n ander taal om die volledige oorklanking te hoor.

solutionPillars.title: Visuele en karakterkonsekwentheid
solutionPillars.friction: Generatiewe modelle stel by elke opname terug, wat veroorsaak dat die gesigte, uitrustings en beligting van karakters voortdurend verander wanneer daar tussen tonele gewissel word.
solutionPillars.solution: Definieer hoofkarakterprofiele, omgewings en visuele style vooraf in Blueprint Room. SceneFlow handhaaf visuele identiteit oor elke weergawe heen om narratiewe onderdompeling te bewaar.

solutionPillars.title: Verteltempo en toneelbeheer
solutionPillars.friction: Om 'n film uit losstaande mikro-opdragte saam te stel, lei tot 'n haperende tempo, emosionele vlakheid en eindelose handmatige redigering op die tydlyn.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Storiebordbou wat by die narratiewe slae begin.
solutionPillars.solution: Regisseer op toneelvlak, nie op opdragvlak nie. Struktureer dramatiese momente, kamerabewegings en storielyne visueel voordat 'n enkele videoraamjie gegenereer word.

solutionPillars.title: Belyning van dialoog en oudio
solutionPillars.friction: Swak gesinkroniseerde lipbewegings, mondbewegings wat nie by die klank pas nie, en stemspore wat los staan van die beeld, ruk kykers onmiddellik uit die drama.
solutionPillars.solution: Dinamiese stemvertolking en presiese lipsinchronisasie is direk in die videoproduksieproses geïntegreer, wat geloofwaardige dialoog lewer sonder eksterne n-produksiestappe.

solutionPillars.title: Wrywing in werkvloei en herrol-moegheid
solutionPillars.friction: Om 'n kortfilm te genereer, behels gewoonlik die hantering van meer as 200 rou videolêers, handmatige opskaling en dosyne mislukte genereringspogings.
solutionPillars.solution: Van konsep tot finale meester-MP4 op een geïntegreerde platform. Blueprint Room hanteer die storie-opset, Production Stage bestuur regie deur middel van strome, en Screening Room lewer jou finale uitvoer.

cards.title: Geanimeerde reeks van 'n volle seisoen met verskeie style. Een konsekwente kunsstyl.
cards.subtitle: Stel die "flat-cel"-styl, die Hart-gesin en die dorp Millwick vas vir die tydperk van die eerste tot die laaste episode. Regisseer die grappie stap vir stap en hersien dan die episode in die vertoningskamer.

solutionPillars.title: Stylistiese konsekwentheid
solutionPillars.friction: Spotprent- en anime-style verwring voortdurend tussen skote: lynwerk verskuif, kleurpalette disintegreer en karakters transformeer in fotorealistiese, ongemaklike gemors.
solutionPillars.solution: Vaslegging van jou estetika vanaf die eerste raampie. SceneFlow sluit karakterontwerpe, lyndiktes en skadu-modelle vir die hele episode vas, sodat jou karakters uniek joune bly.

solutionPillars.title: Oordrewe animasie en fisika
solutionPillars.friction: Generatiewe modelle sukkel met vinnige klugtige aksie, skielike reaksies en die vervormbare fisika van tekenprente, wat energieke grappe in smeltende visuele artefakte verander.
solutionPillars.solution: Skep dinamiese karakterbeweging en ekspressiewe houdings sonder om die geometrie te skend. Regisseer kragtige fisiese komedie, skielike snitte en uitbundige uitdrukkings met volle beheer oor beweging.

solutionPillars.title: Komiese tydsberekening en ritme
solutionPillars.friction: Humor skuil in die pouses en ritmiese snitte. Standaard generatiewe lusse van vyf sekondes dwing ’n ongemaklike tempo af wat die oordrag van die grap vernietig.
solutionPillars.solution: Beheer die tempo van tonele tot op die raampie. Pas dramatiese pouses, die tydsberekening tussen opbou en klimaks, en vinnige reaksieskote direk op die ritme-gebaseerde tydlyn aan voordat die finale weergawe gegenereer word.

solutionPillars.title: Hoë-energie-dialoog en stem-sinkronisering
solutionPillars.friction: Generiese KI-dialoog voel leweloos en meganies, en vernietig die energie wat nodig is vir die vinnige, gevatte woordewisseling van ’n situasiekomedie.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Dinamiese sinchronisasie van stem en uitdrukking.
solutionPillars.solution: Stemlewering word direk gekoppel aan energieke gesigsuitdrukkings. Dialoog, ekspressiewe mondbewegings en komiese klankbane sluit naatloos by mekaar aan vir maksimum komiese effek.

cards.title: Langformaat-dokumentêre programme. Die opkoms van intelligensie.
cards.subtitle: Volg die opkoms van KI en superintelligensie oor verskeie kontinente heen. Elke hoofstuk lyk soos sy eie tydperk – geen moderne voorwerpe in 'n vroeë laboratorium nie, geen 1950-styl stelle in die hede nie.

solutionPillars.title: Visuele akkuraatheid eie aan die tydperk
solutionPillars.friction: Standaard-generatiewe modelle laat dikwels moderne voorwerpe, slimfoonskerms of kleredrag wat nie by die tydperk pas nie, in historiese heropvoerings insypel.
solutionPillars.solution: Stel presiese tydgebonde parameters in — van die filmkorrel van die 1920's tot die teksture van 18de-eeuse kostuums — sodat elke gegenereerde toneel histories outentiek bly.

solutionPillars.title: Enjin vir argief-tussensnitte en B-rol
solutionPillars.friction: Die kombinasie van lang vertellersklank met statiese voorraadbeelde lei tot 'n vinnige afname in kykersgetalle tydens diepgaande ontledings.
solutionPillars.solution: Terwyl jou verteller historiese feite bespreek, genereer SceneFlow outomaties tydgebonde filmiese heruitbeeldings, dokumentoorleggings en argiefstyl-tussensnitte wat direk aan die oudio-transkripsie gekoppel is.

solutionPillars.title: Onderhoud- en „talking-head”-realisme
solutionPillars.friction: Gegenereerde historici, ondersoekers of getuies lyk dikwels kunsmatig, met kakebeenbewegings wat losweg voorkom en onnatuurlike oogkontak.
solutionPillars.solution: Handhaaf realistiese, geloofwaardige onderhoudopstellings met natuurlike mikro-uitdrukkings, akkurate lipsinchronisasie en konsekwente kundige-identiteite oor meerdelige reekse heen.

solutionPillars.title: Episodiese tempo en narratiewe kontinuïteit
solutionPillars.friction: Om die verteller se klank, nabootsings, die onthulling van bewyse en spanningsbouende pouses in 'n episode van 40 minute te balanseer, neem gewoonlik weke in beslag met tradisionele nie-lineêre redigeringsagteware (NLE's).
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Dokumentêre produksieproses gebaseer op narratiewe sleutelmomente
solutionPillars.solution: Struktureer dramatiese spanning, spanningsvolle pouses en die visuele onthulling van bewyse binne Blueprint Room, en lewer 'n volledig saamgestelde meesterlêer in een naatlose proses.

cards.title: Kurrikulumgereede opleidingsreeks met verskeie modules. Een opgeslote sjef.
cards.subtitle: Een sjef, een kombuis, vyf maaltye. Die gesig, die baadjie en die teëls bly onveranderd – van die aftreksel tot by die laaste nagereg.

solutionPillars.title: Konsekwentheid van instrukteur en omgewing
solutionPillars.friction: Generatiewe snitte stel die instrukteur se gesig, drag en klaskamer tussen lesse terug, sodat 'n kursus soos 'n versameling onverwante video's voel.
solutionPillars.solution: Definieer die instrukteur, stel en visuele stelsel eenmalig in Blueprint Room. SceneFlow behou daardie identiteit deurgaans in elke module.

solutionPillars.title: Tempo van die kurrikulum
solutionPillars.friction: Wanneer ’n sillabus in losstaande aanwysings omskep word, gaan die verloop van die les, die uitgewerkte voorbeeld en die pouse voor ’n vasvra verlore.
solutionPillars.solution: Rig elke module as 'n reeks onderrigstappe — voorbereiding, demonstrasie en kontrole — voordat 'n raam weergegee word.

solutionPillars.title: Vertelling en onderrig op die skerm
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: Stem wat die grafiese element misloop.
solutionPillars.friction: Vertelling, byskrifte en diagramme raak uit pas, sodat leerders die een stap hoor terwyl die prent 'n ander een toon.
solutionPillars.solution: Die stem, onderskrifte en visuele onderrig bly in perfekte pas, sodat elke verduideliking saam met die beeldmateriaal wat dit staaf, oorkom.

solutionPillars.title: Kursussamestelling
solutionPillars.friction: Om modules, heropnames en gelokaliseerde weergawes binne 'n tradisionele tydlyn saam te voeg, verander 'n kurrikulumopdatering in 'n produksievertraging.
solutionPillars.solution: Blueprint, Audience Resonance en Screening Room neem 'n module van die uiteensetting tot by Pre-Vis, die growwe snit, tonele en die voltooide kursus.

drama.artStyle: Anamorphic Photorealism · Tungsten, Sub-Zero Slate & Violet-Teal Induction Glow
drama.continuityLock: Gideon Croft, Piper Hayes, Julian Ward & Dr. Clara Vance-Croft · 4 Subterranean & Lakefront Sets · Clara’s 1893 Manifold & Cipher
drama.artLock: Locked anamorphic photorealism across every beat: Gideon Croft’s weathered archivist smock, Piper Hayes’s snow-dusted field coat, Julian Ward’s corporate tactical gear, Clara’s restored 1893 induction manifold, and the progression from 1906 freight tunnels to the frozen Two-Mile Crib.
drama.logline: When a disgraced reporter breaches the subterranean bunker of an isolated infrastructure archivist to activate an 1893 atmospheric energy artifact, the pair must survive an elite strike team led by the corporate risk operative who murdered his wife—culminating in a choice between self-preservation and liberating humanity from artificial scarcity.
drama.seriesSynopsis: Set beneath a climate-battered American Midwest where private utility conglomerate Vane-Calhoun Energy weaponizes rolling winter blackouts to extract municipal concessions, The White City Current spans six 45-minute episodes. Former municipal archivist Gideon Croft and blacklisted investigative journalist Piper Hayes uncover a suppressed 1893 Columbian Exposition resonant-induction network engineered by Gideon’s late wife, Dr. Clara Vance-Croft. Across Season 1, lighting the Chicago Two-Mile Crib in Episode 1 triggers a high-stakes war across historic subterranean infrastructure corridors—from Detroit’s salt-mine substations to Niagara’s decommissioned wheel-pits—pitting public-grid liberation against Senior Risk Director Julian Ward’s private containment directorate.

cast.name: Gideon Croft
cast.descriptor: Former Municipal Infrastructure Archivist (54). Weathered charcoal wool archivist smock, wire-rimmed spectacles, salt-and-pepper beard, calloused draftsman hands; lit by warm 3200K tungsten against cold tunnel slate.

cast.name: Piper Hayes
cast.descriptor: Blacklisted Investigative Energy Reporter (31). Snow-dusted olive field parka, canvas satchel with encrypted drive and brass cipher cylinder, sharp kinetic intensity under violet-teal induction spill.

cast.name: Julian Ward
cast.descriptor: Senior Director of Corporate Risk, Vane-Calhoun Energy (46). Tailored matte-black tactical overcoat, bone-conduction comms, surgical calm; framed with sterile high-contrast institutional lighting.

cast.name: Dr. Clara Vance-Croft
cast.role: Archival & Memory Anchor · Locked Character Sheet
cast.descriptor: Late Resonance Physicist (48). Slate lab coat, copper-wound 1893 calibration rig, warm amber flashback plates and holographic schematic reflections.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Faraday Protocol
episode1Synopsis.duration: 42.5 min (8 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 6 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: A grieving tunnel archivist and a hunted reporter ignite an 1893 wireless power manifold beneath frozen Chicago and fight through two miles of sub-lakebed tunnels to broadcast the truth.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: During a lethal polar vortex engineered by Vane-Calhoun Energy to bankrupt Chicago’s South Side wards, Piper Hayes breaches Gideon Croft’s 1906 freight-tunnel bunker with the missing cryptographic key to his murdered wife Clara’s 1893 resonant induction manifold. Awakening the prototype alerts Julian Ward’s sanitization unit, forcing Gideon and a wounded Piper out of hiding and through steam sluices, an Adams Street pneumatic mail station, and a collapsing 1890s sub-lacustrine intake tunnel to couple the manifold to the offshore Two-Mile Crib.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Forty feet beneath freezing Chicago, Gideon Croft’s chalk-covered vault hums under stolen municipal current while radio dispatches count South Side blackout casualties. Piper Hayes bypasses his perimeter tripwires carrying Clara’s brass cipher and Vane-Calhoun’s load-shedding orders—forcing Gideon to confront the proof that Clara’s death was a corporate assassination.

episodes.title: Subterranean Isolation
episodes.synopsis: Establish Gideon’s defensive isolation in the 1906 Chicago freight tunnels, his obsession with rationalizing Clara’s murder as personal failure while Vane-Calhoun’s polar-vortex blackouts freeze the South Side, and Piper Hayes’s disruptive intrusion with Clara’s final cryptographic cipher.

episodes.title: Unlocking the Faraday Protocol
episodes.synopsis: Stage a fierce ideological collision as Piper confronts Gideon with internal Vane-Calhoun shutoff manifests and Clara’s handwritten plea—shattering his cynicism and forcing him to input the alignment sequence that wakes the resonant induction prototype in a violet electromagnetic surge.

episodes.title: The Claustrophobic Counter-Offensive
episodes.synopsis: Julian Ward’s tactical sanitization squad detonates breach charges into the vault. When Piper takes shrapnel shielding Gideon, he overcomes his instinct to seal himself away alone—guiding her through forgotten drainage sluices and scalding Ward’s contractors with an industrial steam bypass.

episodes.title: Suture and Sub-Station
episodes.synopsis: Taking shelter in a derelict pneumatic mail sorting station beneath Adams Street, Gideon field-sutures Piper’s wound in an intimate decompression beat that binds Clara’s legacy to Piper’s mission and cements Gideon’s commitment to the fight.

episodes.title: Breaching the Harbor Flue
episodes.synopsis: Cornered by Ward’s surface perimeter and timed thermite charges, Gideon and Piper execute an interdependent tactical breakthrough—jury-rigging a pressurized concussion canister in a pneumatic dispatch tube to blow open a ventilation flue to the frozen lakefront.

episodes.title: The Sub-Lacustrine Traverse
episodes.synopsis: Faced with two miles of churning pack ice to reach the offshore Two-Mile Crib, Gideon leads Piper through a hazardous, half-flooded 1890s brick water-intake siphon beneath the frozen lakebed—battling hypothermia, rising icy seepage, and structural collapse to haul her up the intake shaft.

episodes.title: Stand on the Gantry
episodes.synopsis: On the crib’s gale-swept gantry, Ward corners them with a high-voltage inversion relay and offers Gideon underground immunity and lab funding for Clara’s manifold. Gideon rejects corporate co-optation and hotwires Victorian hydraulic flood-gates to route Ward’s reverse charge back through the actuators.

episodes.title: The Harmonic Grid Transmission and Vindication
episodes.synopsis: Piper splices into the microwave uplink to broadcast Vane-Calhoun’s crimes to independent news outlets while Gideon couples Clara’s manifold to the regional array—unleashing a resonant harmonic transmission that restores heat and light across Chicago before Gideon burns his credentials at dawn.

animation.artStyle: 2D Flat-Cel Animation · Bold Ink Outlines & Warm Suburban Palette
animation.continuityLock: 5 Locked Family Character Sheets · Millwick House & Side Porch · Zero Style Drift
animation.artLock: One locked flat-cel style for the whole season: bold ink outlines, warm suburban color, and the same character designs in every episode. The platform can hold many styles. This series does not switch.
animation.logline: In Millwick, the Harts turn a household argument into the week’s joke, and the joke into the reason they still live under one roof.
animation.seriesSynopsis: Set in the civic-ordinance-obsessed town of Millwick, Hart House is a five-episode, 22-minute 2D animated family sitcom built to prove zero off-model drift across an entire broadcast season. Municipal clerk Ruth Hart and night-shift transit mechanic Ellis Hart share a cramped craftsman house with sixteen-year-old debate captain June, nine-year-old fact-collector Milo, and Ruth’s mother Nana Inez, whose “temporary” enclosed side porch has quietly become the emotional center of the home. Every episode turns a small municipal headache into rapid-fire ensemble comedy while keeping identical line weights, warm cel-shaded palettes, and multi-angle character sheets locked from Episode 1 through the Episode 5 household vote.

cast.name: Ruth Hart
cast.descriptor: Millwick Municipal Clerk (42). Terracotta knit cardigan, tortoiseshell glasses, color-coded wall calendar; deadpan vocal timing and expressive eyebrow arcs.

cast.name: Ellis Hart
cast.descriptor: Night-Shift Municipal Bus Mechanic (44). Navy shop coveralls, steel thermos, optimistic garage inventor who solves 5-minute chores with 40-pound contraptions.

cast.name: June Hart
cast.descriptor: High School Debate Captain (16). Mustard hoodie over pleated skirt, annotated town charter in hand; treats every dinner-table rule like a Supreme Court oral argument.

cast.name: Milo Hart
cast.descriptor: Household Archivist & Label-Maker Enthusiast (9). Striped rugby shirt, untied high-tops, industrial label gun; delivers devastatingly literal truths on the comedic beat.

cast.name: Nana Inez
cast.descriptor: Side-Porch Sovereign & Retired Seamstress (71). Embroidered indigo shawl, silver chignon, wicker throne; remembers every zoning variance on the block since 1984.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Sorting Rule
episode1Synopsis.duration: 22 min (4 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 5.5 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: A twelve-category town recycling mandate inspires Ellis to build a motorized garage sorting conveyor that accidentally classifies Nana Inez’s porch belongings as municipal surplus.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: When Millwick enacts Ordinance 412—requiring twelve color-coded curb bins by Thursday morning—Ruth wants quiet compliance so her coworkers at Town Hall cannot gossip, June drafts a constitutional challenge for the council mic, and Ellis constructs a pulley-driven sorting machine in the garage. The machine triumphs on glass bottles before devouring the family’s unlabeled storage boxes, culminating in a living-room standoff when Milo prints a tag reading “Nana’s Temporary Porch Things” and the family must admit nobody knows what “temporary” means.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1 (Cold Open & Act I): Twelve Bins by Thursday
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: At 6:15 a.m. in the locked Hart kitchen, Ruth unveils the town’s twelve-category sorting chart while Ellis returns from night shift with a salvaged bus-door motor. Across fast-cut flat-cel reaction shots, Milo begins labeling household furniture and Nana Inez declares the side porch exempt from municipal jurisdiction.

episodes.title: The Sorting Rule
episodes.synopsis: Millwick issues a new recycling order with twelve categories. Ellis builds a sorting machine in the garage. It works on bottles and then, disastrously, on the family’s unlabeled boxes. June wants to challenge the rule at the town meeting. Ruth wants the curb to look compliant by Thursday. The episode lands when Milo labels one box “Nana’s porch things” and nobody can agree what the label means.

episodes.title: Parade Weather
episodes.synopsis: Rain is forecast for Millwick Day. June wants to cancel her debate-club banner. Milo wants to log the lightning. Nana Inez refuses to wave at a neighbor she has avoided since a fence dispute. Ruth still has to host the block under a tarp. The joke is the tarp. The point is who gets to decide that a celebration happened.

episodes.title: Night Shift Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: Ellis gets home at dawn and cooks for people who are already leaving. June has a tournament. Milo has a field trip. Ruth has a counter shift. For one hour the kitchen is the whole family, and the eggs are the only conversation that fits. A burnt pancake becomes the running argument about whose morning the house is built around.

episodes.title: The Spare Key
episodes.synopsis: Someone has been refilling the cat’s bowl on the mornings Ellis oversleeps. The Harts investigate and find the key they hid under a brick years ago. The neighbor they have been calling nosy has been covering the dawn gap. Nana Inez has to decide whether to take the key back or admit the block has been helping.

episodes.title: The Porch Vote
episodes.synopsis: Nana Inez announces she is done with the “temporary” porch and will move to her sister’s town. The Harts call a household vote. Rebuilding the porch as her real rooms means Ellis’s garage project stops, June’s study corner moves, and Millwick has to permit a change it has been ignoring. The season turns here: the comedy is no longer about a messy week. It is about who gets to stay.

documentary.artStyle: Era-Accurate Archival Realism (1950s 16mm Grain → 1980s CRT → Modern 4K)
documentary.continuityLock: 2 Recurring Witnesses (Dr. Amira Hassan & Kenji Sato) · 12 Global Cities · Strict Period Guardrails
documentary.artLock: Period accuracy is the rule of the picture. A 1956 lab has period wardrobe, film grain, and the machines of that year — no flat screens, no phones. A present-day chapter looks like now. The same two witnesses, Dr. Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato, keep the same faces across every era they appear in.
documentary.logline: A five-part documentary follows intelligence — built, borrowed, and still unfinished — from the first useful machines to the question of a system smarter than its makers.
documentary.seriesSynopsis: Spanning seventy years and twelve cities across five continents, The Long Thought is a five-part, 200-minute documentary series tracing humanity’s attempt to externalize reasoning—from 1956 relay rooms in Manchester and Tokyo to contemporary foundation-model infrastructure and the governance horizon of superintelligence. Anchored by recurring on-camera witnesses Dr. Amira Hassan (Cairo/London) and Kenji Sato (Osaka/Tokyo), SceneFlow’s Historical Style Guardrails lock period-authentic lenses, wardrobe, and room geometry per decade while automatically weaving transcript-synced archival cutaways, schematics, and multi-language narration.

cast.name: Dr. Amira Hassan
cast.descriptor: Mathematical Logician & AI Governance Scholar. Appears in 1980s Cairo/Paris archival recreations (age 28) and present-day 4K London interview plates (age 64) with locked facial structure and vocal cadence.

cast.name: Kenji Sato
cast.descriptor: Industrial Control & Semiconductor Engineer. Tracked from 1980s Osaka/Seoul fabrication floors to contemporary Tokyo robotics archives with natural micro-expressions and lip-sync.

cast.name: The Chronicler (Narrator)
cast.descriptor: Measured, unsensationalist documentary narrator driving transcript-timed archival B-roll and localized audio mixes in English, Spanish, Chinese, and Arabic.

cast.name: Historical Lab & Field Ensemble
cast.descriptor: 1956 Manchester and Tokyo computing pioneers, 1989 Nairobi hospital records analysts, and present-day practitioners in Manila, Accra, and Rotterdam—strictly filtered against modern anachronisms.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Room with the Switches (1950–1968)
episode1Synopsis.duration: 40 min (5 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 6 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: In post-war Manchester, Princeton, and Tokyo, a handful of mathematicians and relay engineers wire rooms the size of gymnasiums to test whether a machine can hold a rule and change its mind.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: Episode 1 reconstructs the physical and philosophical birth of machine intelligence between 1950 and 1968. Moving between 16mm archival-grade recreations of Manchester’s Ferranti Mark 1, Tokyo’s ETL Mark III relay room, and Dartmouth’s 1956 summer study, Dr. Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato examine the artifacts their mentors left behind—showing how early researchers mistook formal logic for human common sense, yet laid the switching architecture that still governs modern compute.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1: The Relay That Remembered (Manchester & Tokyo, 1956)
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Shot in locked 1956 16mm grain with zero modern artifacts, engineers in wool waistcoats trace a fault across clattering electromagnetic relays in Manchester and Tokyo, intercut with crisp 4K present-day interview plates of Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato holding original 5-hole punched tape—closing on a single toggle switch left on through the night.

episodes.title: The Room with the Switches
episodes.synopsis: Mid-century labs in Manchester, Princeton, and Tokyo. Researchers in period dress stand over machines that do one clever thing in a loud room. Amira’s teacher, on a later interview tape, describes the hope without using a single object from the future. Kenji’s uncle services a factory controller the size of a wardrobe. The chapter ends on a switch left in the on position overnight.

episodes.title: The Useful Machine
episodes.synopsis: The 1980s and 1990s. An expert system in a Nairobi hospital records room, a chip floor in Seoul, a translation office in Paris. Beige terminals, CRT glow, clothing and cars of that decade. Amira, young, watches a program suggest a diagnosis a senior clinician rejects. Kenji sees a line stop because a sensor trusted itself. Useful, and already arguing with the people beside it.

episodes.title: The Public Arrival
episodes.synopsis: The 2010s. A Lagos newsroom, a São Paulo classroom, a Berlin kitchen where a phone answers a question a child asked out loud. The model has left the lab. Amira is now the person reporters call. Kenji’s factory posts a notice that the night shift will “consult the system.” The chapter holds on faces reading a screen, not on the screen.

episodes.title: The Acceleration
episodes.synopsis: One present day, three cities. A nurse in Manila, a composer in Accra, a dock planner in Rotterdam. Each uses a system that finishes a sentence they started. The narrator counts what sped up and who was not in the room when the terms were set. Amira and Kenji, older, compare the notices on their doors. The pictures are contemporary: current dress, current streets, current light.

episodes.title: The Question Ahead
episodes.synopsis: The superintelligence horizon, told as a question rather than a prophecy. Amira and Kenji sit in a quiet archive — papers, photographs, and a machine that is not pretending to be a person. They ask what a system smarter than its makers would owe the nurse, the composer, the dock planner, and the people who never touched the switch. The series does not answer. It leaves the obligation in the room.

Unlike avatar slide-readers that cannot demonstrate physical craft, SceneFlow locks Chef Mensah’s face, double-breasted coat, knife station, and green ceramic wall tiles across A-Cam medium teaching beats, B-Cam 90° overhead bench demonstrations, and C-Cam macro simmer/crumb inspections—building cumulative culinary competency from a foundational clear broth to a five-plate graduation service.

episode1Synopsis.title: Module 1: The Broth — Extraction, Clarity & Heat Control
episode1Synopsis.duration: 15 min (3 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 5 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: Chef Lila Mensah teaches heat management, aromatics, and skimming discipline through a crystal-clear foundation broth that powers the rest of the curriculum.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: In Module 1, Chef Lila Mensah establishes the Harbor Street workbench and teaches the foundational skill of the course: transforming cold water, roasted bones or root vegetables, and aromatics into a clear, structured broth. Structured into three instructional chapters—(1) Cold Start & Knife Mise en Place, (2) The Convection Simmer & Skim, and (3) Late-Stage Salt Calibration & Clarity Check—learners master thermal control before touching flour or roast proteins in later modules.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1: Cold Water, Clean Bones & The First Simmer
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Opening on A-Cam in the daylight-balanced Harbor Street Kitchen, Chef Lila Mensah introduces the five-plate syllabus, switches to a locked 90° overhead B-Cam to demonstrate uniform mirepoix cuts and cold-water submersion, and brings the stockpot to its first lazy convection bubble alongside apprentices Marcus and Priya.

episodes.title: The Broth
episodes.synopsis: Lila starts with a clear broth: knife, bones or vegetables, heat, and patience. She shows the simmer, the skim, and the moment salt goes in. The kitchen, the coat, and her face are established as the locked set. The check is a spoonful that tastes finished, not cloudy.

episodes.title: The Bread
episodes.synopsis: Same bench, same chef. Dough, time, and the feel of a proved loaf. Lila ties the broth’s lesson about patience to the wait the dough requires. Students shape, score, and bake. The check is a crumb that is open, not gummy, and a note on what they would change next time.

episodes.title: The Vegetable Main
episodes.synopsis: A pan of greens and grains that has to feed the whole class, not a camera. Lila shows a sauce built from the broth, seasoning for a group, and how to hold color in the vegetables. The check is a plate that is the same in the first bowl and the last.

episodes.title: The Celebration Roast
episodes.synopsis: A center plate for a night that matters: roast, rest, and a side that uses yesterday’s bread. Lila keeps the same station and the same voice while the stakes of the plate go up. The check is carving for a table, not a single hero shot.

episodes.title: The Last Sweet
episodes.synopsis: A dessert that needs the heat control of module 1, the timing of module 2, and the seasoning eye of module 3. Then the class sets all five plates as one meal. Lila walks the pass in the same coat, in the same kitchen. The course turns from lessons into a service.

Met SceneFlow kan jy die kultuur, streek en demografiese groep waarvoor jy skep, spesifiseer; die storie aan die hand van daardie gehoor evalueer voordat jy dit weergee; en dan óf 'n meesterweergawe met oorklanking óf 'n aparte weergawe wat sterk by die spesifieke gehoor aanklank vind, versprei.

howWeScore.title: Hoe Audience Resonance werk
howWeScore.description: Audience Resonance kombineer ontleding van die narratiewe struktuur (duidelikheid, tempo, emosionele verloop) met die mate waarin dit by die teikenpersona pas – gebaseer op die gehoor wat jy in Blueprint gedefinieer het, en nie bloot op oppervlakkige statistieke of behoudsyfers van ná publikasie nie. Wanneer jou gehoorbeskrywing kulturele aspekte insluit, voeg die ontleding 'n toets vir egtheid by wat aspekte soos name, dialek, gebruike, geloof en sensitiwiteite in ag neem. Aanbevelings word aan spesifieke dele van die draaiboek gekoppel, sodat jy probleme kan regstel voordat agente die videogenerering uitvoer.
bullets: Evalueer Blueprint en die teks aan die hand van jou vermelde teikengehoor.
Kontroles vir kulturele egtheid ten opsigte van name, dialek, gebruike, geloof en sensitiwiteite
Aanbevelings op afdelingsvlak — nie ’n “vertrou ons”-syfer uit ’n swart boks nie
Voer dit uit voordat jy baie aan weergawe (rendering) bestee, nie ná publikasie nie.

Pre-vis is wat jy aan ateljee-bestuurders, beleggers en vervaardigers toon om goedkeuring vir 'n projek te verkry. SceneFlow verhef produksie van 'n hulpmiddel vir verbruikersskeppers tot 'n bate van ondernemingsgehalte binne die produksiepyplyn.
